 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and the OKC Thunder will host Devin Booker and the Phoenix Suns at 7 p.m. CT Monday.
 OKC (3-0) earned a 108-101 home win over the Los Angeles Clippers on Sunday. Phoenix (1-1) secured a 131-122 home win over the Golden State Warriors on Saturday.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Thunder will be short-handed on what marks the second night of a back-to-back stretch. It'll be without Chet Holmgren (right patellar tendinitis), Cason Wallace (left shoulder soreness) and Jalen Williams (left lower leg injury).
 Here's everything you need to know about Monday's game between the Thunder and Suns :

 Thunder vs Suns predictions, picks
 Justin Martinez: Phoenix 111, OKC 108
 OKC will be short-handed on what marks the second night of a back-to-back stretch, and it'll also be less than 24 hours removed from watching Jalen Williams sustain a significant left leg injury. That's a lot to overcome, even for a Thunder team with championship experience and league-leading depth. I'm giving the edge to the Suns in this one.
